content: घटक {%a.%} [घटयति घट्-णिच् ण्वुल्] .²1 Exerting oneself, striving for; एते सत्पुरुषाः परार्थघटकाः स्वार्थं परित्यज्य ये <ls>Bh. 2. 74</ls>. .²2 Bringing about, accomplishing. .²3 Forming a constituent part, constituent, component. .{@-कः@} .²1 A tree that produces fruit without apparent flowers. .²2 A match-maker, an agent who ascertains genealogies and negotiates matrimonial alliances. .²3 A genealogist.
